title: Hot and Sour Mushroom Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
1 packet instant ramen noodles (flavour sachet not used)
method: In a deep saucepan, fry the onion gently in spray oil for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chilli and mushrooms and fry gently for another 5 minutes.
Pour in the hot stock, add the tamarind paste, soy sauce and honey and stir well.
Add the instant noodles to the pot and simmer for 2 minutes until the noodles are cooked. Serve immediately, scattered with fresh coriander.
notes: Use fine or medium egg noodles instead of instant ramen. Crush leftover ramen noodles as a crunchy topping for salads or as a breadcrumb replacement.
